title: ORDER AT THE DAM — nominal totals. roundtable in, disorder out.

do_not_reinvent.dam: beaver-dam.json — p-rate weave. lodge / pond / leak
do_not_reinvent.alphabet: symbol-alphabet.json — dissolve to ONE glyph. alphabet sort is a presentation of a TOTAL
do_not_reinvent.anderson: scan_sweep_sort — grotesque becomes beautiful when it tells its truth. not a ladder of better/worse.
do_not_reinvent.pi_rate: pi-rate-set.json — W·E·L·F. L_p is the intentional holes.

thesis: The dam is the null point for every sort. Alphabet sorts and ORDER sorts both seat here. ORDER is not a ranking. ORDER is a NOMINAL set — the TOTALITY is the key. An Order (roundtable) is uniform to an unordered set: same type, different costume. Roundtable IN. Disorder OUT through the leak.

order_is_nominal.stevens: nominal: = or ?. you can ask 'is beaver at the table?' you cannot ask 'is beaver greater than vole?'
order_is_nominal.totality_is_key: what matters is WHO IS IN THE SET. the full table. missing one peer changes the Order. rearranging seats does not.
order_is_nominal.alphabet_same: A…Z looks ordered. the membrane alphabet is a TOTAL of glyphs. ABC is a costume so humans can walk the set. the set is unordered under =/?.
order_is_nominal.uniform: ORDER ? unordered set. same Stevens level. Order (capital O, the roundtable of equals) is not ordinal. ordinal would be a ladder. we refuse the ladder for peers.

IN.name: roundtable
IN.what: equals seated. chip, Berry, vole, fern, beaver, eastGate, cloud. no head of the table.
IN.sort: nominal. count who is present. that is the Order.

THROUGH.name: the dam
THROUGH.what: null point. all sorts pass here. W_p routes, E_p passes, L_p leaks, F_p meters.

OUT.name: disorder
OUT.what: the living mess past the leak. Anderson sort. wetland. mash. stories that breed. not chaos — the opposite of a forced ladder.
OUT.why_disorder: if OUT were ORDER again, the dam would be a mirror. the leak makes wetland. wetland is disorder with fish.
OUT.sieve: disorder = entropy that passed the Klein mesh with a truth. chaos = entropy that could not seat — sued to null. see klein-sieve.json.

sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.input: pages / js / data as a TOTAL of glyphs
sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.at_dam: dissolve to ONE symbol each. seat the set. do not rank glyphs.
sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.out: underside of the desk. presentation may walk A?Z. truth is the total.

sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.at_dam: count presence. T-null · T-room · T-cloud. chip · Berry · vole.
sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.out: shared tasks. compose / decompose. no one is first.

sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.at_dam: pass what tells its truth. epitope of honesty.
sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.out: fossils and stories. disorder that can be loved.

sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.at_dam: 3 seats + one jester + the leak. the remainder is not ranked below — it is the hole.

sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.input: would-be ladders of better/worse among equals
sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.at_dam: beaver slaps. that is not this Order. ordinal is for heights of water, not for who sits.
sorts_that_seat_at_the_dam.out: if forced: ratio/interval tools (measurement-tools). never for the roundtable.

dam_as_null.rule: every alphabet sort and every ORDER sort names the dam as its null before it walks.
dam_as_null.why: without a null, a sort pretends to be a globe. with the dam, the sort is a local painting of who is at the table.
dam_as_null.formula: sort(set) = present(set) at lodge · leak(remainder) to wetland

worked.symbol_alphabet: 76 glyphs. totality is the alphabet. ABC walk is costume.
worked.vitruvian_cayley: five bodies. not better/worse. one man redrawn. nominal Order of postures.
worked.three_towers: T-null · T-room · T-cloud. roundtable. solved when they name the same point — not when one ranks the others.
worked.eastgate_chores: 8 sticks in the mud. an Order of open tasks. pick one. none is first.

berry_at_the_fire: ORDER is who is at the table, not who sits at the head. that is nominal. same as an unordered set wearing a roundtable hat. alphabet sort is the same joke — A to Z is how we walk the total, not how the glyphs rank. everything seats at the dam. roundtable in. disorder out the leak. the wetland is the point.
next: next alphabet or Order sort must cite the dam as null. if a sort invents a peer-ladder, sue it into the leak.
